name: gemini-core
description: Keeps the Gemini keys and tier of every Gemini mod, and each mod's model and thinking level, in one place: adds $.gemini, which builds their Gemini requests, reads the answers and moves to the next key after a quota or key error, and picks a model from Google's list.

apiKey.title: Gemini API key
apiKey.description: Leave empty to use the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable. Every Gemini mod uses this key. Several keys separated by commas are tried in turn after a quota or key error.

tier.title: Gemini tier
tier.description: free: Google may use what the Gemini mods send to improve its products and human reviewers may read it. paid: a billing-enabled key. /gemini-core free|paid overrides it.
